analogs.covers: Role: follows herds and predators to the dying grounds and bullies its way onto carcasses
Ground game: a tall walker that picks off young and weakened animals and pushes others off kills

headline: A committee of vultures that walks the ground like a marabou stork and bullies hunters off their kills.

setting.label: Everywhere the herds and predators go
setting.note: Found across the entire map. Follows migrating herds and predators and feeds at common dying grounds.

playsLike: You are a large aerial carnivore in a 'committee' of up to 3 with temporary bonds. You are the laziest predator on the map. First choice is to bully other carnivores off their kills or steal their hunts. When you do hunt, the easiest targets come first: offspring, the death-scarred, the injured and albinos. Solo you take up to Medium tier; a group takes Large and albino Apexes. Solitary birds scavenge at their own risk. You're a poor parent, and your chicks squabble.

why.text: Its groups are a 'committee' and several groups form a 'procession'. Committee is the collective noun for vultures (official inspiration).
Follows migrating herds and predators and feeds at the dying grounds, like vultures circling the migration.
Prefers to 'bully other carnivores off of their kills'. Marabou storks shove even vultures aside at carcasses.
Observes and follows prey for long periods and picks off offspring and the weak on the ground, like a marabou walking the plains.
Large tier, 2,750 combat weight, the fastest air sprint on the roster (1,350) but only for 50 s.

notLike: Vultures rarely kill; Quetzalcoatlus readily hunts offspring and easy targets.
